packages.title: Voice copy: one short privacy line in the sheet; Voz in plain words
files: App/test/review_tasks_test.dart (only if its capture-listening preview needs the new key)
brief: Context: b6 round 1 ran P34 (U9, UX-115). The options are out of capture and the Voz screen exists (Ajustes › Otros ajustes › Voz, voice_settings_screen.dart). The reviewer (verify-b6-r1-A) found U9 only partly done, first failure, and found one more problem on Voz.

U9 / UX-491 (R1A-1, S2) — what the last attempt did and why it failed: the first-capture privacy note in the sheet shows the whole `capturePrivacy` paragraph (4 sentences, about 60 Spanish words: reconocimiento local, extracción de tareas con IA, audio guardado, capturas pendientes), in a Flexible + SingleChildScrollView (voice_task_screen.dart:1669-1681, key `capture-privacy`), and the words area was given `flex: 2` (:1648) to share the height with it. In the render App/build/capture-listening-es-2x.png the note takes about a third of the words area, its last visible line is cut in half, and it appears while the user is speaking. U9 asked for 'a small line under the words'.

Fix: add a new key `capturePrivacyLine`, used only by the sheet: EN `TaskFlow sends your words online to turn them into tasks. More in Settings.` / ES `TaskFlow envía tus palabras por internet para convertirlas en tareas. Más en Ajustes.` / CA `TaskFlow envia les teves paraules per internet per convertir-les en tasques. Més a Configuració.` Keep `capturePrivacy` for the Voz screen only (voice_settings_screen.dart:195).

In the sheet, replace the note's Flexible + SingleChildScrollView with a plain `Text(l10n.capturePrivacyLine, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)` in `bodySmall` with `onSurfaceVariant`, inside a `Padding(top: 8)`. Keep the key `capture-privacy` on that widget so the existing tests still find it. Remove `flex: 2` from the words' Flexible (:1648), so the words get the remaining height again. Update the comment above the note. Don't change when the note shows (`_privacy`: first microphone use on this device only, :702-712, :772).

UX-492 (R1A-2, S2), on the Voz screen (voice_settings_screen.dart:133-190): the second radio group has no heading, its options are technical, and two messages tell the user to record or type, which only makes sense on the capture sheet.

(1) Add a heading above the second RadioGroup, styled exactly like the `speechLanguage` heading (:106-109, titleSmall, horizontal padding 24). New key `speechMethod`: EN `How speech becomes text` / ES `Cómo se pasa la voz a texto` / CA `Com es passa la veu a text`.

(2) Reword in place, because only Voz uses these keys (grep of App/lib): `onDeviceTranscript` → EN `On this phone, as you speak` / ES `En el teléfono, mientras hablas` / CA `Al telèfon, mentre parles`; `onlineAudio` → EN `Online, after you finish` / ES `En línea, al terminar` / CA `En línia, en acabar`; `onDeviceUnavailable` → EN `This phone can’t do this language by itself, so TaskFlow does it online.` / ES `Este teléfono no puede con este idioma por sí solo, así que TaskFlow lo hace en línea.` / CA `Aquest telèfon no pot amb aquest idioma tot sol, així que TaskFlow ho fa en línia.`

(3) Add a Voz-only key `voiceSetupRequested` and use it at voice_settings_screen.dart:77 instead of `captureSetupRequested`: EN `Follow Android’s steps, then tap Check again.` / ES `Sigue los pasos de Android y luego pulsa Comprobar de nuevo.` / CA `Segueix els passos d’Android i després toca Torna a comprovar-ho.` (The button names match `checkAgain` in each catalog.) Leave `captureSetupRequested` untouched: the capture sheet still uses it (App/lib/l10n/capture_messages.dart:33).

Run `flutter gen-l10n` after the ARB edits. Update the existing tests that look for `capturePrivacy` in the sheet (voice_settings_test.dart:176, :220, :304, :312) to the new key; the ones that check the Voz screen keep `capturePrivacy`.

Don't touch: the Voz language rows, `setUpSpeech`, `checkAgain`, the `capturePrivacy` paragraph on Voz, `captureSpeechLanguage`, NativeSpeechBridge.kt, and anything about free dictations. UX-493 (the language for online transcription) is the next package, P82.
acceptance: Widget test: on the first capture, in Spanish at 2× text on 360×740 while listening, the sheet shows `TaskFlow envía tus palabras por internet para convertirlas en tareas. Más en Ajustes.` (key `capture-privacy`) and not the `capturePrivacy` paragraph; on the second capture neither shows.
Widget test: in Spanish at 2× text on 360×740, with the privacy line showing and enough dictated words to fill the area, the newest words are visible and nothing overflows.

Render: re-run `flutter test --no-pub --dart-define=WRITE_REVIEW_PREVIEWS=true test/review_tasks_test.dart`; in App/build/capture-listening-es-2x.png the note is one or two whole lines and no line is cut.

Widget test: Ajustes › Otros ajustes › Voz in Spanish shows `Cómo se pasa la voz a texto` above the options `En el teléfono, mientras hablas` and `En línea, al terminar`, and the Voz screen still shows the `capturePrivacy` paragraph.

Widget test: on Voz in Spanish, with on-device speech unusable for the language, the message reads `Este teléfono no puede con este idioma por sí solo, así que TaskFlow lo hace en línea.`; after tapping `Configurar la transcripción local` the banner reads `Sigue los pasos de Android y luego pulsa Comprobar de nuevo.` No text on Voz contains `escribe`, `Graba` or `escribiendo`.
Widget test: Voz in Catalan at 2× text on 320×640: the heading and both options fit without overflow.
Code: `captureSetupRequested` is still used by capture_messages.dart; `capturePrivacy` is used only by voice_settings_screen.dart.
deviceChecks: First capture after a fresh install, phone in Spanish: one short line under the words while speaking, nothing cut.

packages.title: The Voz language reaches online transcription
files: App/test/capture_recovery_test.dart (or the existing processor test that checks the ai/drafts/ request)
brief: UX-493 (R1A-3, S2, from P34): P34 made every on-device recognition use the Voz language (`_speechLanguage`, voice_task_screen.dart:438-446, passed at :812-814). But when the online way is used — because the user picked `Online, after you finish`, or because on-device speech can't do the language, which is common for Catalan — the `ai/drafts/` request (capture_processor.dart:143-160) sends no language. The server then guesses the language from the audio (Backend/core/ai.py:112, 'Transcribe the speech verbatim in its original language'). A user who chose Català may get Spanish words. Reviewer's inference; the outcome needs a device.

App side (this package): (1) Add an optional `language` field (String?, e.g. `ca-ES`) to CaptureSession, in the constructor, copyWith, toJson and fromJson. Captures are stored as JSON in the `data` column (capture_store.dart:71-77), so no database migration is needed; a stored capture with no `language` loads as null. (2) Add an optional `language` parameter to `CaptureStore.create` (capture_store.dart:44-70) and keep it in the session. Leave the external-share path (:110-127) without one. (3) In voice_task_screen.dart, pass `language: _speechLanguage` to `_store.create` (:535) whenever the capture is created for speech (audio or the recognizer); not for typed text. Make sure `_speechLanguage` is already set at that point (it is loaded in `_load`). (4) In capture_processor.dart, add `if (existing.language != null) 'language': existing.language` to the `ai/drafts/` data map.
Don't change the free-tier digest, the timezone, the Voz screen, or NativeSpeechBridge.kt. Don't hide `Idioma de voz` (the reviewer's fallback): sending the language is possible, so it isn't needed.

Server side (not for this package; you can't change Backend/): the drafts serializer (Backend/core/serializers.py, near :295) must accept an optional `language`, and `transcribe` / `_transcribe_once` (Backend/core/ai.py:88, :108-112) must tell the model which language the speaker chose. Report in your notes that the app now sends `language`, so the main session can do the server half. Django serializers ignore unknown fields, so sending it now is safe.
acceptance: Unit test: a speech capture created with the speech language `ca-ES` sends `language: ca-ES` in the `ai/drafts/` request data.
Unit test: a typed capture, and a capture stored before this change (JSON without `language`), send no `language` and still process.
Unit test: CaptureSession with `language` survives toJson/fromJson.
deviceChecks: After the server half is done: Voz on Català and `En línia, en acabar`, say a Catalan sentence → the words come back in Catalan.

packages.title: Sign-in: the email-in-use button names itself; a known account offers recovery
brief: UX-488 (R1D-1, S2, from P77). What P77 did: in create mode, an email-in-use error shows an OutlinedButton `sign-in-with-email` (login_screen.dart:426-439) that calls `_mode()`, switching to sign-in with the email and password kept. Its label reuses `signIn` (`Iniciar sesión`), the same as the submit button, so it looks like it signs in but only switches mode. And it can loop: someone who forgot an old account, or made it with Google, types a new password in create mode → email in use → taps the button → submits → wrong credentials → UX-402's `Crear una cuenta con este correo` (:595-608) → create mode → email in use again.

(1) Give the button its own label, the mirror of UX-402's: new key `signInWithEmail`, EN `Sign in with this email` / ES `Iniciar sesión con este correo` / CA `Inicia la sessió amb aquest correu`. Keep its key, place and behaviour.

(2) Add one bool to the state, e.g. `_accountExists`. Set it to true when the user reaches sign-in through the `sign-in-with-email` button. Set it back to false when the email text changes, and on any other mode switch (the create, sign-in and recovery links). When it is true and sign-in fails with the wrong-credentials error (today's `unknownAccount` case), show the same OutlinedButton slot with key `recover-with-email` and the existing `forgotPassword` string (`¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?`), calling `_mode(recover: true)`, instead of `create-account-with-email`. `_mode` already keeps the email; recovery clears the password, as it does today.

Don't touch: the password validators (UX-484), the error texts, the headings, Google sign-in, the small `¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?` text link. A normal sign-in failure (not reached through the email-in-use button) still offers `Crear una cuenta con este correo` (UX-402).
acceptance: Widget test, Spanish, 2× text on 360×740: create mode, the server answers email in use → the button reads `Iniciar sesión con este correo` → tap → sign-in mode with the email kept → submit → wrong credentials → a button `¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?` shows and `Crear una cuenta con este correo` doesn't → tap → `Recupera tu contraseña` with the email kept.
Widget test: after reaching sign-in through that button, changing the email and getting wrong credentials offers `Crear una cuenta con este correo` again.
Widget test: a direct sign-in with wrong credentials still offers `Crear una cuenta con este correo` (UX-402 unchanged).
Widget test: the button label in English is `Sign in with this email` and in Catalan `Inicia la sessió amb aquest correu`; at 2× text on 320×640 in Catalan it wraps without overflow.
deviceChecks: Against the real server, with an account made with Google: create with that email → email in use → sign in with this email → wrong password → the recovery button opens recovery with the email kept, and the recovery email arrives (inferred: a Google-only account may have no password to recover).

packages.title: An empty share says there's no text
brief: UX-494 (R1A-4, S1, from P20): CaptureEntryBridge.kt:65-66 shows `share_too_long` both when the shared text is empty and when it is over 4,000 characters, so an empty share says `TaskFlow admite hasta 4000 caracteres. Comparte un texto más corto.`

Add a string `share_empty` in the three strings.xml files: EN `There’s no text to add. Share some text with TaskFlow.` / ES `No hay texto que añadir. Comparte un texto con TaskFlow.` / CA `No hi ha cap text per afegir. Comparteix un text amb TaskFlow.` Escape apostrophes the way these files already do (the typographic ’ needs no escape; a straight ' does).

Split the branch: `text.isEmpty()` → `R.string.share_empty`; `text.length > 4000` → `R.string.share_too_long`. Both still return. Change nothing else in the bridge. A build-only compile is fine if you can run it; don't install or uninstall anything.
acceptance: Unit test (native_resources_test.dart): `share_empty` exists in values, values-es and values-ca with the exact copy above.
Unit test (native_resources_test.dart): CaptureEntryBridge.kt uses `R.string.share_empty` for the empty case and `R.string.share_too_long` only for the over-4,000 case.
deviceChecks: Phone in Spanish: share an empty text/plain to TaskFlow → `No hay texto que añadir. Comparte un texto con TaskFlow.`

packages.title: Catalan: 'Grup suprimit', like the button
brief: UX-490 (R1C-1, S1, from P78): P78 followed its brief and set CA `groupDeleted` to `Grup eliminat` (app_ca.arb:508). The Catalan catalog says `suprimir` for delete everywhere else: the button just tapped is `Suprimeix` (:157) and deleting a project says `Projecte suprimit` (:507). The brief was wrong; the catalog's term wins.

Set CA `groupDeleted` to `Grup suprimit`, run `flutter gen-l10n`, and update the Catalan string check in App/test/groups_screen_test.dart (around :152-161). Leave EN `Group deleted` and ES `Grupo eliminado` unchanged.
acceptance: Widget test: deleting a group in Catalan lands on the screen underneath with `Grup suprimit`.

packages.title: Time-zone search shows which name matched
brief: UX-489 (R1D-2, S1, from P79): `_cityAliases` (regional_settings_screen.dart:168-231) maps zones to Spanish and Catalan names, and some are other cities in the same zone: Pekín → Shanghai, Quito → Guayaquil, Nueva Delhi and Bombay → Kolkata, Montreal → Toronto, Tel Aviv → Jerusalem, Ciudad del Cabo → Johannesburg, Canarias/Tenerife → Canary. The row (:270-273) shows only the tz city, so `Pekín` lists a row reading `Shanghai` and the user can't tell it's right. `montreal` lists two rows, `Montreal` and `Toronto`.

(1) Change the alias values from one space-separated string to a list of names (`Map<String, List<String>>`), so multi-word names such as `Nueva Delhi`, `Nova Delhi` and `Ciudad del Cabo` stay whole. Keep every name except the ones in (3).

(2) In the picker, a zone still matches when `matchesSearch` finds the query in its city, its id or any alias. When the query doesn't match `'${timeZoneName(z)} $z'` and matches an alias, show that alias (the first one in the list that `matchesSearch` accepts on its own; if none does, the first alias) as the row's `subtitle`. Rows that match by city or id, and every row when the query is empty, stay as they are: title only.
(3) Remove the `America/Toronto` entry, whose only names are `Montreal Montréal` (:198): accent folding already finds `America/Montreal`. Toronto itself still matches by its tz city.
Don't change the listed zones, `_listedZone`, the Settings row, or any ARB file; the subtitle is the alias as written, so it needs no translation.
acceptance: Widget test, Spanish: searching `pekin` lists one row, titled `Shanghai` with the subtitle `Pekín`.
Widget test: searching `montreal` lists exactly one row, `Montreal`, with no subtitle.
Widget test: searching `Londres` lists `London` with the subtitle `Londres`; searching `london` lists `London` with no subtitle.
Widget test, Catalan at 2× text on 360×740: searching `Nova Delhi` lists `Kolkata` with the subtitle `Nova Delhi`, without overflow.
